body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2TDvuJ2KygqHcBPtkDgePBK)_

Step 3 of 5. **Base: `415-devonthink-browse-tags` (#415)**. Stack: #414 → #415 → #418 → #419 → #420. (Replaces #417, whose branch name did not match its number.)

## What
- `sp-devonthink-search` (`C-c k d f`): one front end over two engines. DEVONthink search by default (query passed as typed: `name:`, `kind:`, `tags:`, quotes, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`; first 50 hits with kind and page count). `C-u` asks for the engine: `devonthink`, `litdb: meaning`, `litdb: words`, `litdb: both` (run through the existing `sp-litdb-search`).
- Hits share the browser's category, so its Embark actions work, plus `s` similar records (DEVONthink "see also") and `v` text preview.
- `sp-devonthink-similar-to-note` (`C-c k d a`).
- Literate doc `docs/tangles/academic/sp-devonthink-search.org`; README row.

## Not tested
- AppleScript not run: `page count of`, `kind of`, `location of` on search results; `compare record … to database …`; `plain text of` with `text 1 thru N of`.
- Tested here: 7 ERT tests and the tangle check.

## Manual testing
Mac, fish, `~/.config/emacs-modular`, DEVONthink open on `literature`.
- [ ] Check out: `cd ~/dotfiles; git fetch origin 418-devonthink-search; git checkout 418-devonthink-search`, restart Emacs.
- [ ] Unit tests: `cd ~/.config/emacs-modular; for f in browse search; do emacs -Q --batch -L libraries/modules/academic -l ert -l tests/sp-devonthink-$f-test.el -f ert-run-tests-batch-and-exit; done` → 6 and 7 pass.
- [ ] `C-c k d f`, query `Therborn` → hits in rank order, each annotated e.g. `PDF Document, 212 pages`; choosing one opens it in DEVONthink. Time it (design measured about 0.5 s).
- [ ] Operators: `"value form" kind:pdf` returns only PDFs with the phrase; `name:okane` returns records by file name.
- [ ] Embark (`C-.`) on a hit: `v` shows a `*devonthink preview*` buffer; `n` litnote; `t` tags.
- [ ] `s` on a hit → "Similar to KEY.pdf:" list; choosing one opens it. In a litnote with `#+devonthink:`, `C-c k d a` does the same.
- [ ] `C-u C-c k d f` → `litdb: meaning`, query `exchange abstraction` → page hits with scores like `C-c k l`; choosing one opens DEVONthink at that page (needs the litdb index: `C-c k I`). Try `litdb: words` and `litdb: both`.
- [ ] Query `zzzzzzqq` → "No records found".

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01WWLNiDWYwkgX4eqm2SVoTC

comment_regular_data.body:
**Merge order:** merge #437 and #415 first. New commit here: `sp-devonthink-similar-to-note` follows `crossref` (read-only, so it does not ask; the echo area says it is using the parent's record).

**Extra manual test:**
- [ ] On the litnote of a chapter with no record of its own, `C-c k d a`: the message says `... using the record of PARENT` and similar records of the parent are listed.

**Revert:** revert the commit "Follow crossref in sp-devonthink-similar-to-note".
